notes: answeredCategories === totalCategories so isDraft is false. The DRAFT
watermark path is therefore NOT covered - see README.
engagementId/generatedAt/layer were added in D2 step 3, for the same reason
they were added to haiw.json in step 1 and taiw.json in step 2: the PDF and
the markdown now take a ReportMeta, and a clock-derived date would make them
un-reproducible from one day to the next. generatedAt was null before that,
because none of the three BAIW generators accepted one - they called
new Date() directly, and the harness could only normalise the result to a
<DATE> token. The gap CSV reads none of the three - its baseline is
unaffected, and that is checked rather than assumed.
